name: EPIC 231899923
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 10.7 solar radii and 1.25 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231899923 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.714625 (16th-84th percentiles 10.540582-10.877019), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231899923: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4660.9966 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 231899923 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2049.160156 (16th-84th percentiles 2028.28125-2071.054688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,049 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.25 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,661 K at its surface.
